evals.prompt: We changed the STG-to-LTG promotion contract and rejected two simpler alternatives. Update the repository documentation without creating duplicate sources of truth.
evals.expected_output: Updates the owning normative design, records rationale in a decision note, updates completion evidence only when verified, and removes or adjusts any resolved TODO without duplicating history.

evals.prompt: A small benchmark found that a candidate reranker improved recall but increased token cost. Document the result; do not change the default design policy.
evals.expected_output: Places measured evidence in experiments, preserves configuration and caveats, and does not turn the result into a normative or default-policy claim.

evals.prompt: A public startup command changed and an implemented decision was revised. Keep Chinese and English documentation useful without demanding exact paragraph parity.
evals.expected_output: Updates both public entry documents and normally both decision-language variants, preserves commands and warnings, and runs the structural documentation check.
